display_name: Bao Viet motor vehicle physical damage insurance rules (Decision 5688/QD-BHBV, 9 December 2021): the whole document, as cover, settlement and duties

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese appears only in `-- src:N |` comments printed by tools/vnsrc.py quote from line N of the raw text, and in short runs in comments and Markdown, each checked by tools/vnsrc.py check to occur verbatim in the source.

documents.authority: private contract terms published by the insurer (ibaoviet.vn), not law

aids.use: read only, for forks tagged LAW:; not encoded

scope: The whole document: the important notice; Part I definitions 1-14; Part II Articles 1-9; Part III Articles 10-15 with the depreciation table; Part IV Articles 16-23 (BVVC01-BVVC07 as changes to Part III; Article 23 declined by name, its clauses not being in the document). Everything left to the certificate is an input. Declined by name: an Article 23 clause, certificate reduction rates (4.1.6), a sum insured above value (12.1), a 15.1.3 ground with no rate fixed, 4.2.3 without the authority's conclusion, and missing inputs. Not encoded: the Law on Insurance Business (read for LAW: forks), the TCVN vehicle standard, public holidays, and the across-insurers cap in Article 8's chapeau. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F1: def 8, src 71: "Người lái xe được bảo hiểm": the person driving the insured vehicle, or the insured driver? Taken: (i): the definition's point is consent ("với sự đồng ý"), which (ii) would make redundant.
forks.F2: def 4, src 58; 12.2, 13.2: "Giá trị thị trường" (12.2, 13.2.1, 13.2.2) is not the defined "Giá thị trường"; and is 12.3's "value" the market value? Taken: (i): the Article 12 heading writes "giá trị bảo hiểm (giá thị trường)", equating them.
forks.F3: notice, src 7-12: Is the signed request evidence that the purchaser understood every term, exclusions included? Taken: Encoded as the notice says (`the notice — …`); whether that satisfies Article 19(2) is not decided (finding X12).
forks.F4: 10.1, src 424-426: Does "sudden, unforeseeable" qualify every listed case, or accidents only? Taken: (i): consistent with LAW: Article 16(5) (aid 407-408), which requires every insured risk to be sudden and unforeseeable.
forks.F5: 11.3-11.7, 15.1.3(b): Limbs that name "Người điều khiển xe" need the definition-8 driver; limbs with no subject? Taken: (i): the text names the defined term in some limbs and not others. So 11.4's drugs limb, 11.5's wrong-way, turn and lights limbs, 11.6 and 11.7 reach anyone driving; 11.3, 11.4's alcohol limb and 11.5's signals limb only a consenting driver.
forks.F6: passim: "ngày" (day): calendar or working? Taken: (i): the Rules say "ngày làm việc" where they mean working days (4.2.7, 5.2.4).
forks.F7: passim: Is the day of the event counted in "N ngày kể từ ngày X"? Taken: (i): the Civil Code's rule as this encoder understands it (outside knowledge, unverified); it is also the purchaser-favourable reading for the purchaser's deadlines.
forks.F8: 2.1, src 118: Are the first and last days on the certificate inside the period? Taken: (i). It also decides that a 1 January-31 December contract runs 12 months for BVVC04.
forks.F9: 3.1.2, 3.2.2, 3.2.4, 4.2.7: "Tương ứng với thời gian còn lại": pro rata by what? Taken: (i): nothing in the Rules prints a scale.
forks.F10: 2.2, 3.1.1: Is an agreement allowing the premium to be owed (3.1.1) a written agreement on the time for payment (2.2)? Taken: (i): both postpone payment by agreement.
forks.F11: 10.1.3, 11.12, Art 18: Is a flooded street a "natural catastrophe"? Is a parked car "operating" (hoạt động) in a flooded area? Taken: Flood: an input (`a natural catastrophe beyond human control` against `flooding in rain, storm or flood`). Parked: (i), so a parked car's drowned engine is covered by 10.1.3 without BVVC03 (finding X18).
forks.F12: 2.4, src 126-129: When does a contract ended at the former owner's request end? Taken: (i): the request is made "on" the transfer and the Rules give no other date.
forks.F13: 3.1.1, 3.2.1: "Chấm dứt vào ngày X": in effect on X or not? Taken: (i): 3.1.1's "the day after the due date" only makes sense if the contract is not in effect on that day; 3.2.1 uses the same words.
forks.F14: def 12, 13.1.2(b): Is depreciation measured at the start of cover or at the loss? Taken: (i): def 12 counts "to the month the insurance takes effect".
forks.F15: 4.2.7, 5.2.4: What is a working day? Taken: (i), with the holidays supplied by the caller.
forks.F16: 4.2.3, src 206-208: After the authority concludes, how long to pay? Taken: (i): the file is "complete and valid" from the conclusion, and the insurer itself verifies nothing more.
forks.F17: 4.2.7, src 229-230: Pro rata from when? Taken: (i).
forks.F18: 6.2, src 316-320: Who may appoint an independent assessor? Taken: (i) as written; the Law's wider route is recorded, not encoded.
forks.F19: Art 8, src 390-400: What is double insurance? Taken: (i) as written; the difference is finding X4.
forks.F20: 9.1, src 407-410: From when does the year run if the insured did not know of the event? Taken: (i) as written; the Law adds (ii).
forks.F21: 15.1.4, src 640-642: Do children under 7 count for 15.1.4's overload? Taken: (i): the same measure as the exclusion it adjoins, and the purchaser-favourable reading.
forks.F22: 9.4, src 419-421: Does "tại Việt Nam" qualify arbitration as well as the courts? Taken: (i).
forks.F23: 11.13, src 481-483: "Các bộ phận khác": does another tyre count? Taken: (i): (ii) would let two tyres save each other and empty the exclusion.
forks.F24: 11.17, src 496-500: Does "trừ các thiết bị lắp thêm theo quy định" lift both limbs? Taken: (i), purchaser-favourable.
forks.F25: 10.1.4, 11.15: Is taking by fraud or abuse of trust "trộm, cướp"? Taken: (i): 11.15 names fraud separately (finding X21).
forks.F26: 11.15, src 485-486: Is the parenthesis (hired, lent, debt, dispute) a limit? Taken: (i), purchaser-favourable; under F25 it changes no answer.
forks.F27: 10.2, 12.4, Art 15: Are the 10.2 costs inside the 12.4 cap, the deductible, the reduction and Article 8's share? Taken: (i): 10.2 pays them "ngoài số tiền bồi thường" (besides the compensation), and the other provisions speak of the compensation.
forks.F28: 15.1.1(c), src 606-610: "Không giữ nguyên hiện trường thiệt hại, tự ý di chuyển …": one limb or two? Taken: (i): under (ii) the safety exception would never save someone who moved the car for safety.
forks.F29: 12.1, src 502-505: A sum insured above the value? Taken: Declined by name; the Law settles it.
forks.F30: 13.1.2(a), src 526-533: Does depreciation apply to a vehicle insured below value? Taken: (i), the more natural reading of the term. Under LAW: Article 24, (ii) is arguable and would pay more.
forks.F31: 13.2.1(a), src 552-553: Which "reasonable cost" is compared with 75%? Taken: (i): the same words as 13.1.2(b).
forks.F32: 13.3.2, src 566-571: A kept wreck below value: deduct the whole valuation or the insurer's share? Taken: (i): "giá trị thu hồi" is the value the insurer would recover.
forks.F33: 13.4 with 8, 12.4, 13.1.2(a), 13.3.2: Where do the steps 13.4 does not order go? Taken: A choice; each step is in `bvvcx-claim.l4` and can be moved.
forks.F34: 14.1, src 584-586: Does the deductible apply to a total loss? Taken: (i): the definition governs, and it is purchaser-favourable.
forks.F35: 14.3, src 593-595: A certificate deductible below 500,000? Taken: (i): 14.3 says another figure "will be stated on the certificate".
forks.F36: 15.1.1, src 599-602: Is a theft (or a natural catastrophe) a "tai nạn"? Taken: (i): the Rules use "tai nạn" for every loss (6.1, 7.1.1). Under LAW: Article 24, (ii) is arguable; it would remove finding X3.
forks.F37: Part IV, src 661-662: "Một trong các Điều khoản": one clause only? Taken: (i).
forks.F38: Art 20, src 735-736: "Tổng số tiền bồi thường không vượt quá số tiền bảo hiểm trên ngày": a cap on each day or on the total? Taken: (i): (ii) would make the per-event sum unreachable (finding X16).
forks.F39: Art 21, src 745-749: "Bồi thường theo số tiền bảo hiểm (đối với thiệt hại toàn bộ)": pay the sum insured, or up to it? Taken: (i): 13.2.2 already caps at the sum insured, so (ii) would add nothing (finding X20).
forks.F40: Arts 18-19, 13.4: On what does a clause deductible ("10% số tiền bồi thường") fall? Taken: (i).
forks.F41: 11.4, src 459-460: No alcohol reading taken? Taken: (i); refusing a test is 15.1.3(b).
forks.F42: 11.3, src 453-454: "Đối với loại xe ô tô bắt buộc phải có Giấy phép lái xe": which cars need a licence? Taken: (i); the traffic law is not in the sources.
forks.F43: 13.1.3, src 547-549: Damage to half or less of the paint? Taken: (i).
forks.F44: 2.2, src 120-122: Paid in full when? Taken: (i).
forks.F45: 1.1, src 106-108: "Đã nộp phí bảo hiểm": any premium, or all of it? Taken: (i).
forks.F46: 5.2.4(b), 15.1.5(b): Is a change in risk "not notified" before the 15 working days have run? Taken: (i), as written (finding X24).
forks.F47: 3.2.1, src 153-158: May a notice name a date before the notice? Taken: (i) as written (finding X23). LAW: Article 26 (aid 623-635) limits the grounds for unilateral termination; the Rules' "theo quy định pháp luật" defers to it, and the encoding does not test grounds.
forks.F48: 15.1.1(a), src 601-602: Is a late call excused by force majeure? Taken: (i) as written (finding X17).
forks.F49: Art 7, 4.2.3: When is a file "đầy đủ, hợp lệ"? Taken: Not decided: the caller supplies the date the complete file was received (finding X6).
forks.F50: Art 19 with 11.13: Is a stolen tyre alone a tyre "damaged alone"? Taken: (i).

self_check.vnsrc_gate: vnsrc check: 1031 src: lines, 345 Vietnamese runs, 0 problems

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run. Every expected value in the tests modules was written by the same session that wrote the rules (worked by hand from the source text before it was asserted; the generated tests read their figures from the raw text by script).
